Ugmuls 5.5e Automation · v0.8.1

Your class features.
Part of the flow.

Raise a Paladin’s aura, empower an Artificer’s attack, or call on an oath’s power—right where you already cast, attack and roll. 0.8.1 brings more class features into one connected workflow, with resource tracking and controls that keep the table in charge.

The built-in spell and monster libraries remain ready to use. This update adds unified Paladin auras, Artificer assistance, oath features and simpler spellbook tools, while reducing repeated work behind the scenes.

Unified Paladin auras

One aura.
Your oath comes with it.

  • Bring the benefits together. One attached, level-scaled Region combines supported Protection, Courage and oath benefits. The granting Paladin is named on received effects, and overlapping Protection bonuses do not stack.
  • Choose your protection. Use actor-window controls to enable the aura and choose a preferred Protection source. Genie Paladins select one elemental resistance from their native feature card; choosing another replaces it and updates allies.
  • Keep the map clear. Paladin aura outlines appear only on the Regions layer. Their benefits remain active during normal play. Disable old Aura Effects Paladin emitters before using this replacement.

Set up Paladin auras →

Oath powers

Call on your oath.
Keep the follow-through.

  • Noble Genies. Elemental Smite choices appear on Divine Smite damage cards, with Channel Divinity spending, target choices and supported save/escape handling. Elemental Rebuke offers an element chooser, Reaction tracking, half-damage selection and return save/damage prompts.
  • Ancients. Nature’s Wrath prompts its end-of-turn Strength save, clearing the originating restraint on success without another action or use.
  • Devotion. Activate Sacred Weapon from melee attack configuration with its enchantment and reversible lighting. Smite of Protection shares half cover through the aura until your next turn starts. Holy Nimbus adds supported enemy turn-start damage and Holy Ward.
  • Vengeance. Activate Vow of Enmity from weapon/unarmed attack configuration; transfer it freely after the mark reaches 0 HP without resetting its duration. Avenging Angel adds turn-start fear saves and source-specific Advantage, with fear clearing on damage.
  • Tell the table. Sacred Weapon and Vow activations or transfers post a short public notice before the refreshed attack.

Explore oath features →

Artificer assistance

A spark of genius.
Right when it matters.

  • Flash of Genius. Use the button on a failed check or save to add the Intelligence bonus, consume a feature use and track the Reaction in combat. Range and ownership checks keep the choice with eligible players.
  • Arcane Jolt. Choose destructive energy in damage configuration. A natively linked Steel Defender uses the main Artificer’s charges, sharing the once-per-turn limit.
  • Arcane Firearm. Add the optional typed 1d8 to one eligible Artificer spell damage roll per cast, with a type choice for mixed-damage spells.

Explore Artificer controls →

Spellbooks & rolls

More choices.
Less scrolling.

  • Add several spells at once. Add Spell opens class-filtered compendium results with a selection panel. Check the spells you want and confirm once, without dragging each item. Existing spells are skipped.
  • Choose the Smite, then its level. Separate Smite and Smite Level rows keep long lists manageable. Level stays blank and disabled until a spell is chosen, then defaults to a free cast or the lowest qualifying slot, with upcasting available.
  • Keep the right recommendation. Confirmed critical hits carry into the damage prompt. Monster area cards default to Targeted; Smite slot spending no longer creates false prepared-spell notices under Monk’s Combat Details.

Explore spellbook tools →

Performance & table control

Keep the flow.
Keep the decisions.

Shared helper preparation and fewer movement-driven reaction-card redraws reduce repeated work. Reaction eligibility is checked when the action’s card is shown and again when clicked, while resource, effect, turn, result and Undo updates remain connected. Explicit save, damage, effect and animation order is preserved.

Arcane Jolt healing, Steel Defender reactions, Genie teleports and forced movement, Inspiring Smite allocation, Living Legend and other documented situational powers remain manual. Holy Nimbus supplies bright illumination and sunlight metadata; specialized creature sunlight rules may still need table handling. Automatic damage and effect application remain optional.

Working with other modules

Bring the features together.
Avoid doubling up.

If you use the unified Paladin aura, disable the matching Paladin emitters in Aura Effects so both modules do not apply the same benefits. Other auras can remain under your existing setup.

Smite of Protection supplies the native half-cover status. Simple Cover 5e and AC5e handle cover and bypass features such as Sharpshooter; Ugmul’s automation does not add a second cover calculation.

For supported features, choose one automation to manage each effect or resource. Running an item macro or another module’s equivalent automation alongside it can duplicate prompts, buffs or spending.
